entities.name: Martin Luther King Jr.
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Baptist minister and leader of the American civil rights movement who advanced nonviolent civil disobedience. His leadership from the Montgomery Bus Boycott (1955) through the March on Washington (1963) transformed American society and inspired global human rights movements.
